content:
OpenAI is developing a feature that lets users export stickers they create in ChatGPT directly to WhatsApp. Here are the details.

The feature is currently under development

No matter where you are or how old you are, you probably can't go a day—or even a few hours—without sending or receiving WhatsApp stickers.

For those unfamiliar, stickers in messaging apps are small images users can send in chats, similar to emojis or GIFs. They are typically organised into sticker packs, ranging from custom illustrations to small meme images with text.

WhatsApp itself already comes equipped with an AI-powered sticker creation feature, using Meta AI to generate images based on text prompts. Now, according to Android Authority, OpenAI appears to be working on bringing a similar sticker creation feature to ChatGPT.

According to the website's report, the latest version of the ChatGPT Android app contains strings related to creating, exporting, and downloading stickers. The website noted:

ChatGPT Stickers Add to chat app Add to WhatsApp WhatsApp (minimum 3) Unable to add stickers to WhatsApp Download stickers The feature itself is called "ChatGPT Stickers" and will offer users the option to add stickers to messaging apps. However, it currently appears to only support WhatsApp. Users can tap the "Add to WhatsApp" option to add their custom-made stickers to WhatsApp as a custom sticker pack.

Android Authority added that the minimum requirement of three stickers is a stipulation of WhatsApp itself, not a limitation imposed by OpenAI.

Since the feature was discovered through APK teardown analysis, it remains unclear when—or if—it will be officially released to the public.
